course.title: Industrial Management and Entrepreneurship Development
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value:
A job is rated in terms of wages of Tk.600 per day. The standard time set for the job.is 10 15   
days, 8hrs/day. Two workers have taken 76 and 83hours respectively for the completion of   
the job. A bonus of 75% on the time taken will be given only to those who have completed   
the job in the standard time. Calculate the earnings of each individual by Bedaux plan. Here   
1B stands for 0.9 standard work minute and it includes working time as well as time for rest.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
